name: Camping 101: First Aid
summary: At the Lion's Pride Inn, Michelle Belle shows travelers how to prepare for camp. In Goldshire, you can learn to make a First Aid Kit for the road ahead.

sections.title: Field Medicine on the Road
sections.body: Travel across Elwynn Forest can leave you wounded, far from a town healer or inn. First Aid lets you tend your own injuries and care for yourself without relying on others. Bandages offer help with bleeding and trauma, without arcane rituals or holy supplication.

sections.title: Supplies for the Campsite
sections.body: A campsite offers a place to rest amid the dangers of the wild. At the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, Michelle Belle teaches skilled practitioners to assemble First Aid Kits. Keep medical supplies at camp so a weary party can treat injuries and regain strength before facing the perils ahead.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: Adventurers who have learned basic First Aid seek Michelle Belle in Goldshire. She teaches them to make a First Aid Kit and stock a wilderness camp with medical supplies.

faq.q: Who do I need to speak with in Goldshire?
faq.answer: Speak with Michelle Belle, a First Aid trainer in Goldshire. Once you demonstrate sufficient skill, she teaches you techniques for making camping supplies suited to field medicine.

faq.q: Why is First Aid important for travelers?
faq.answer: First Aid helps travelers tend injuries from beasts, bandits, and harsh elements. It lets anyone, whether or not they wield divine or arcane magic, bandage wounds and recover between skirmishes.
Goldshire is the primary hamlet in Elwynn Forest, just south of Stormwind City along the main trade road. It is a central hub for supplies and local trainers, with respite at the Lion's Pride Inn.

faq.q: Do I need prior training to complete this task?
faq.answer: Yes. Michelle Belle asks you to demonstrate proficiency in First Aid before teaching you to make camp kits.

faq.q: How does a First Aid Kit fit into camping?
aliases: why make a first aid kit
faq.answer: A wilderness campsite provides a safe perimeter to recuperate. A First Aid Kit keeps bandages and remedies close at hand, supplies necessary to save lives far from town healers.

angles.text: Goldshire is a vital crossroads for Alliance travelers heading from Northshire into Elwynn.
Without innate healing spells, you as a warrior rely on bandages and field kits to endure long campaigns in the wild.
As a rogue operating in the shadows far from support, you depend on field medicine to bandage bleeding gashes before moving on to your next mark.
